summary: A hiker reported a deceased person in a remote mountain area in the 13000 block of Lefthand Canyon Drive, unincorporated Boulder County near Ward; BCSO deputies searched before dark on Feb 11 without locating anything; on Feb 12 the Boulder County Sheriff's Office, BCSO Emergency Services, the Coroner's Office, and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group returned and located the unidentified deceased person; cause/manner and identity under investigation (BCSO case 17-859)
location: 13000 block of Lefthand Canyon Drive, near Ward
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office (with Rocky Mountain Rescue Group)
notes: DATE PIN — body located Feb 12, 2017 (reported Feb 11); zero Boulder 2017-02-11/12 rows before insert.
